text: זֵכֶר יְלִיד נוּן. וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי אוּרִי אֶפְנוּן. יִזָּכְרוּ בְּרִנּוּן. פִּלְאָם לִזְכּוֹר: יֶקֶשׁ בְּרַק הַשָּׁנוּן. אִם הָשְׁלַף לְתַאֲנוּן. יַקְשִׁיב תַּחֲנוּן. חֲנוּנָיו לִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר טַעַם שֹׁפְטִים. וְאוֹת קְצִיר חִטִּים. טֶפֶשׁ שׁוֹטִים. יְחַתֵּל מִלִּזְכּוֹר: טֹרַח אַרְבַּעַת שְׁפָטִים. אִם נֶעֶנְשׁוּ נִשְׁפָּטִים. טֶבַע מִשְׁפָּטִים. אֲשֶׁר שָׂם יִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר חֲצוֹת לַיְלָה. וְתוֹדוֹת מִשְׁפְּטֵי לַיְלָה. חֹשֶׁךְ בְּאִישׁוֹן לַיְלָה. נִגּוּנוֹ לָמוֹ יִזְכּוֹר: חֵקֶר מִפְקַד לַיְלָה. יַגִּיהַּ בְּלַהַב לַיְלָה. חֹק הֶגֶה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה. לְגִיהָם יִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר זֶה זְבוּל. אֲשֶׁר בְּבִצְעִי חָבוּל. זְדוֹנוֹת סָבוּל. עוֹד בַּל יִזְכּוֹר: זַעַם כַּמַּבּוּל. אִם יָצְאָה לְחַבּוּל. זִכְרֹן יֶרַח בּוּל. לְחֶמְלָה יִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר וְכַח
דֶּלֶת. בְּעַד תְּמִימִים בְּזַעַם. עַד בֹּא קִצָּם. צֵאת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נֹחַ וְאֵת כָּל־הַחַיָּה וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה וַיַּעֲבֵר אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֹׁכּוּ הַמָּיִם:
עֲשֵׂה פֶלֶא לְחַיִּים. לְבַל יִהְיוּ כַּמֵּתִים. הֲיֵשׁ אֲמִתְּךָ. בַּקֶּבֶר לְזִכָּרוֹן: עוֹרַרְתָּ אָז בְּפֹעַל. עוֹרְרֵנוּ בְּלֹא פֹעַל. הֲלֹא לְנִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ. תַּעַשׂ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ: וְנֶאֱמַר טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:
פְּנֵה אֱלֹהִים. בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי גַנִּים. מַקְשִׁיב לְנִדְבָּרֵימוֹ. בְּדַת לְזִכָּרוֹן: פָּעֳלָם לְפָנֶיךָ. וּשְׂכָרָם אִתָּךְ. אוֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים. בַּסֵּפֶר לְזִכָּרוֹן:

He remembers (Joshua) the son of Nun, and the illuminating words of him who comes from Yephuneh, (Caleb), may they be recalled in prayer so that their deeds should be remembered. When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for grief, may He hear and remember the supplications of those He has favoured. He remembers the noble judges and the sign given by Samuel at the time of the wheat harvest. He heals the folly of the simple, so that it is no longer remembered. When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for the four punishments, may He remember the nature of the judgments He gave them. May He remember the hymns of praise in which David, at midnight, praised the rules of the night, may He remember his song in the darkness of the night on their behalf. May He illuminate the nightly search by the fire of the night upon the altar; the law in which they study by day and by night, may He remember for their healing. He remembers the palace that was taken from me on account of my selfishness. May He no longer recall that it was laden with deliberate sins. When anger, as at the time of the flood, is aroused in destruction, let Him remember the month of Bul (the completion of the Temple) in compassion. He re-
the storm until their destiny arrives and they go forth for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the cattle that were with him in the ark and God caused a wind to pass over the earth and the waters subsided’.

Perform wonders for the living lest they become like the dead; is then Thy truth in the grave for remembrance? Once Thou didst pity because of noble deeds; pity us now even though we are without deeds; wilt Thou not make for Thy wonders a remembrance.

As it is written in Thy holy words: ‘A memorial has He made for His wonders, gracious and compassionate is the Lord’. And it was said: ‘He gave food to those that fear Him, He will remember His covenant for ever’.

Turn, O God, to those who sit in the gardens (houses of study), listen how they speak of Thy law for remembrance. Let their work appear before Thee; though they eat the bread of anguish, their reward is with Thee in the book of remembrance.
